title: Sales Development agent: connect to Salesforce CRM through the Salesforce MCP server
summary: The integration, permissions, licensing and published Copilot Credit charges are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The roadmap facts match the record, and the page correctly distinguishes rolling-out status from preview documentation. The activation route should extend to the audience selection that it controls.
